rules.title: Community rules
rules.intro: DeadIsland is where gamers look for a partner and teammates. A few simple rules keep it good for everyone.

age.title: 18+ only
age.text: The site is for adults only. We remove profiles of anyone under 18.

real.title: Be yourself
real.text: Your real name or nickname, your own photos and honest info about your games. Other people’s photos and fake profiles are not allowed.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: No insults, threats, harassment or discrimination. A skip or a “no” is never a reason for aggression.

spam.title: No spam or ads
spam.text: Don’t send ads, links to other services, or requests for money or in-game items.

enforce.title: What happens if rules are broken
enforce.text: Report through the ⋮ menu on a profile or in chat. We review reports and may remove a profile or ban an account.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Short and honest: what DeadIsland stores, who sees it and how to delete it.

what.title: What we store
what.text: Your email and sign-in method; your profile (name, date of birth, city, bio, photo, games, platforms, genres, play times); gaming contacts (Discord, Steam, PSN, Xbox); likes, matches, messages, blocks, reports and support requests.

who.title: Who sees it
who.text: Signed-in players see your profile (your age, not your date of birth). Gaming contacts unlock only after a mutual like. Messages are visible only to the two people in the chat. Reports and support requests are seen only by the admins.

where.title: Where data is stored
where.text: On Google Firebase servers. We don’t sell or share data with advertisers; the site has no ads and no third-party trackers.

local.title: In your browser
local.text: Your browser remembers the language, feed and filter settings and a few hints you have already seen. This stays on your device.

delete.title: How to delete your account
delete.text: Contact support with the topic “Delete account” from the same email. We will delete your profile, contacts, likes, matches and messages.

safety.title: Dating safety
safety.intro: Most people here are gamers just like you. A few habits still help you stay out of trouble.

contacts.title: Take your time with contacts
contacts.text: Play together and chat first. Share your phone number, address or workplace only with people you trust.

money.title: Never send money
money.text: No money, skins, in-game items or accounts. Requests for them are almost always a scam.

meet.title: Meet in a public place first
meet.text: Pick a café, a gaming club or an esports event. Tell a friend where you are going and get there on your own.

trust.title: Trust your gut
trust.text: If something feels off, you can simply leave or end the conversation. You don’t owe anyone anything.

report.title: Tell us
report.text: Use the ⋮ menu on a profile or in chat to report and block. If you are threatened, contact the police (112).

support.title: Support
support.lead: Tell us what happened and we will reply to your email.
support.sentText: Thank you! We will reply to {{email}}.
